note: Script-side fixes check (2026-10-22; docs/144 §8, docs/145 §9, docs/147 §6). Order: the three *-verify jobs first (5 min each, daytime and noisy machine OK: counters prove the mechanism), then the clean-night timing pairs (SV + BP spreads, SV unseen per switch), ~3 h. jobs.note: CORRECTNESS, daytime OK (noisy machine fine: counters, not timing), 5 min. All four spread switches on for the whole load; repro night-maintenance-clock sets 22:00, so at the measured 11-14 sim-minutes per real second (rng.json of the 2026-10-21 spreads jobs) midnight fires ~10 s and 3 AM ~25 s into the window and again every ~100-130 s: >= 2 nights in 5 min. Proves per counter: every pass ran to its end (passes >= 1, none stopped or finished early, decay threw 0), every tick of ours stayed under 8 ms incl. the world scan for inventories and the hot-spot pick (docs/145 §9, docs/147 §6; kSliceUs 2 ms + one unit, 8 ms leaves room for a noisy machine), Overwatch's 21 other types ran at their slots.
